source_note: Every retained completed command has a stable before/after source inventory. Check phases have different inventories: early full core tests precede the reducer and semantic node-capacity fixes; final edited-slice and semantic targets cover those fixes. Default app, audio and CLI tests precede the reducer argument tuple, Object button/footer captions, the semantic capacity exception and fixture corrections. The exact replacement, semantic, app Object, rendered Group/Place and real store registration targets cover those changes. Native QA and the passing Macro replay precede final footer and capacity corrections. The last lint cleanup boxes the existing captured-delete variant and removes a test clone. Final lint, build, focused app deletion tests and the rendered deletion replay use the final source inventory. Group/Place captures precede only that internal cleanup; their visible controls did not change. No single clean full optional app run or full workspace test run is claimed.
limits: All full-product requirements and Gates A through G remain open or partial; ib/ab and beat-owned temporal attachments are not implemented by this increment.

Unit and targeted test counts overlap. Optional app unit testing passed 792 cases with one manually scheduled fixture failure; the corrected case passed separately, as did the optional headless target.
Full workspace tests were not rerun. Strict Clippy covers all workspace targets and the optional UI harness configuration.
Native keyboard events, accessibility observations and an inspected 2x screenshot establish bounded behavior and appearance only. Not physical keyboard, OS IME, VoiceOver or acoustic qualification.
Native QA overlapped compilation and does not measure response time. Large-project performance and complete editorial workflow acceptance remain open.
The first CLI failure's full log was overwritten by the corrected run. A clearly labeled retained tool-output excerpt preserves that failure.
